messages:
julia (support): FYI customer acme-inc reports mass provisioning failures + unexpected billing ramp after a manual SCIM sync. They see 401s and a KMS unwrap error in the response; p95 latency spiked.

luca (sre): Can you paste the request_id and the exact response body? Which endpoint and auth method (SSO token vs API key)?

julia (support): Route: POST /v1/tenants/sync job_id=job_2345. Customer curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/sync \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXX' \ 
  -d '{"external_id":"acme-1234"}'
```
Response they got:
```
{"error":"provisioning_failed","message":"KMS unwrap failed","request_id":"r_0a1b2c"}
```
They said the client retried automatically and billing spiked.

margo (support-eng): I pulled trace r_0a1b2c — HSM returned an unwrap failure then our provisioner retried 5x in ~30s. Logs show:
```
2026-03-01T10:12:03Z provisioner ERROR unwrap failed: KMS-6b4
2026-03-01T10:12:03Z provisioner WARN retrying (1/5)
```

ankit (identity): 401 is odd together with KMS unwrap. Are we hitting an expired SAML assertion for the SCIM flow? Did the IdP send assertion with reduced TTL? @julia got any idp logs?

julia (support): Customer re-ran a manual SCIM sync after a deprov. They use SAML IdP. Obfuscated assertion snippet they pasted shows groups: "eng,ops" and a short NotOnOrAfter value.

priya (payments): Billing note: retries could generate many provisioning calls; if unwrap fails quickly the job may spin and bill. We should identify invoices impacted and apply credits.

emily (security): We need an audit export for compliance: preserve KMS unwrap logs, SCIM events, and provisioning request bodies for 2026-03-01 09:00–11:00 UTC. @julia please request retention hold.

luca (sre): Temporary mitigation: disable aggressive retries for provisioning jobs in eu-west-1 and switch affected hosts to fallback KMS key (we rotated primary last week). I'll kick a canary rollout.

deploy-bot: deploy started: rollout id d-7789, canary 10% -> 25% :rocket:

kms-bot: Alert: key rotation incomplete on cluster eu-west-1, missing material on 2/6 HSM nodes.

margo (support-eng): After flipping to fallback key, unwrap succeeded for the same request_id on retry 0 — suggests primary key material missing on subset of HSMs. Opening ticket with HSM vendor (HSM-INC-592).

ankit (identity): Also saw SAML tokens with a 60s shorter TTL for SCIM flows — that could cause transient 401s mid-sync. I'll patch the assertion TTL for provisioner sessions and push a small fix.

priya (payments): We'll prepare invoice list and apply credits for retry charges. Need list of affected tenant IDs and request_ids.

emily (security): Filing incident INC-2026-032. Action: collect KMS unwrap logs, SCIM audit lines, provisioning bodies, billing trace. Also review retention policy for KMS error windows.

julia (support): Action items: 1) request audit export for acme-1234 (julia) 2) HSM vendor ticket (luca) 3) SAML TTL patch (ankit) 4) billing credits & invoice list (priya) 5) update runbook to disable aggressive retries on provisioning jobs (margo). I'll update customer after we confirm export.

luca (sre): ETA vendor response ~4h. If they don't respond escalate per SLA.

priya (payments): Will share invoice ids and proposed credits by EOD.

margo (support-eng): I'll update the runbook with a check to avoid unbounded retries when KMS returns unwrap errors and ensure the provisioner records request_ids for billing reconciliation.

emily (security): Also flag for a retention gap: if HSM returns errors we may not persist full unwrap telemetry long enough. Add to backlog for retention improvement.

julia (support): cc @oncall if escalation needed later :eyes: I'll close the loop with the customer and share the export link when available.

luca (sre): Noted — posting updates in this thread as vendor and telemetry come in.

julia (support): Closing for now; will re-open if vendor or customer reports recurrence.
